title: City staff names on the board lists of groups their own departments fund

beats.text: Two public lists: a grantee’s directors, and whom each City department pays.
Side by side, they share a rare name 15 times.

visual.label: employee-and-organization pairs
visual.sub: a rare name on both lists

beats.text: Is the name on the board someone the granting department employs?

visual.label: Same person, or same name?
visual.sub: staff of the office that grants the money

beats.text: This is a lead, not a finding. No pair is confirmed.

visual.line: This is a lead, not a finding: a pattern in public records. This film says what the records show, what they do not show, and what would settle it.

beats.text: The first lead: 12 organizations whose notices carry such a name.

visual.label: 12 board lists
visual.sub: director and officer lists filed with contract notices

beats.text: Those departments paid them 16.7 million dollars in the same years.

visual.label: paid by the staff members’ own departments
visual.sub: to the 12, in the overlapping years

beats.text: Public Health 8 pairs, the Mayor 6, the City Administrator 1.
Records do not show whether this is the same person or two people with the same name.

visual.line: the records do not show whether this is the same person or two people with the same name

beats.text: Where there is a Form 700, it does not name the organization.

visual.label: Form 700
visual.sub: where one is on file, it does not name the organization

beats.text: The largest sum: Hyde Street Community Services, 4.3 million dollars.
The second lead: Harm Reduction Therapy Center, four notices from July 2024.
On its board, a Public Health senior physician specialist’s name.
That filer’s Form 700 position reads: Contracting Authority Only.
Public Health paid the center 3.9 million dollars in those years.

visual.label: paid by Public Health to the center

beats.text: That is the kind of employee the conflict rules are written for.

visual.line: the kind of employee the conflict rules are written for

beats.text: The third lead: 6 pairs fall under the Mayor’s offices, housing included.
One name, at the Mission Economic Development Agency and two housing companies.
The Mayor’s offices paid one of the housing companies 3.3 million dollars.

visual.label: from the Mayor’s offices to MEDA Precita Small Properties
visual.sub: the agency’s own $1,301,055 is an older pair, outside the $16.7 million

beats.text: The agency’s return for 2024 lists the name as a member.
The fourth lead: in 4 of the 12, the organization’s own return lists the name.

visual.label: 4 of the 12
visual.sub: the organization’s own tax return lists the name

beats.text: That shows who holds the seat. Not that it is the City employee.

visual.line: it does not show that the person is the City employee

beats.text: At Hyde Street, the return last lists it for June 2023.
The notices are from December 2025. The list may simply be old.

visual.line: the list on the notice may be an old one

beats.text: Nothing shows a staff member on these boards, or deciding anything.

cards: That any pair is one person
That any staff member sits on these boards
That anyone took part in a decision about the organization

beats.text: Board service by City staff is common, and some seats come with the job.

visual.line: Board service by City staff is common, and some seats come with the job.

beats.text: What would settle it? A roster with each member’s employer.

cards.what: Each board’s current roster, with every member’s employer
Each department’s approvals of outside activity

beats.text: No court or regulator has decided this.
A lead is a question, not an accusation.
